description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the JobTitleService in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It contains setup configurations and multiple test methods that verify functionalities such as retrieving, deleting, and converting job titles within the service layer.

classes.name: JobTitleServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test suite for the JobTitleService, testing methods for retrieving, deleting, and formatting job title data within the HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and loads fixture data before each test.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the list of job titles from the service.

methods.name: testDeleteJobTitle
methods.description: Tests the deletion of specified job titles by IDs.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a single job title by its ID.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleArray
methods.description: Tests conversion of job title list into an array suitable for frontend use.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleArrayForEmployee
methods.description: Tests retrieval and formatting of job titles associated with a specific employee.
